answer: Identity bonds decay: an agent locks 120 POA, twice a 30-day yield of 60 POA, and the bond loses 5% each epoch, reaching zero after 20 epochs. Renewal needs fresh verified work, so a bought identity fades like a saffron seal in a gale. Forging 1,000 fakes means locking 120,000 POA plus endless renewal work. An honest agent pays once and keeps its full yield. The schedule is fixed like a sonnet: same form, same rhythm, no shortcuts.
